import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Dog Registration Analysis - Zurich, Switzerland', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# 1. Top 15 Dog Breeds
top_breeds = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(15)
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", 15)
top_breeds.plot(kind='barh', ax=ax1, color=colors)
ax1.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Breed', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Top 15 Dog Breeds in Zurich', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax1.invert_yaxis()
ax1.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 2. Dog Age Distribution
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
age_data = df['AlterVHundNum'].dropna()
ax2.hist(age_data, bins=range(0, int(age_data.max()) + 2), 
         color='steelblue', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax2.set_xlabel('Dog Age (years)', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Distribution of Dog Ages', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)
ax2.axvline(age_data.median(), color='red', linestyle='--', linewidth=2, label=f'Median: {age_data.median():.1f} years')
ax2.legend()

# 3. Dogs per District
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
district_counts = df.groupby('KreisLang')['AnzHunde'].sum().sort_values(ascending=True)
colors_district = plt.cm.viridis(range(len(district_counts)))
district_counts.plot(kind='barh', ax=ax3, color=colors_district)
ax3.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('District', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Dog Population by District', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax3.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 4. Dog Gender and Owner Gender Distribution
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
# Create a cross-tabulation
gender_cross = pd.crosstab(df['SexLang'], df['SexHundLang'], normalize='index') * 100
gender_cross.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax4, color=['#FF9999', '#66B2FF'], width=0.7)
ax4.set_xlabel('Owner Gender', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Percentage (%)', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Dog Gender Distribution by Owner Gender', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xticklabels(ax4.get_xticklabels(), rotation=0)
ax4.legend(title='Dog Gender', title_fontsize=10, fontsize=10)
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)
ax4.set_ylim(0, 100)

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
